topic.coverageNote: Open clinician review of severe ANCA-associated vasculitis that separates microscopic polyangiitis from granulomatosis with polyangiitis and eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis, and states the pauci-immune small-vessel pathology, the MPO and PR3 antibodies, the kidney and lung patterns, and the worse kidney prognosis of MPO-ANCA MPA. A Watts epidemiology algorithm was not used as a clinical text.

mcqs.question: Into which diseases does this review subdivide ANCA-associated vasculitis?

options.A: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis, microscopic polyangiitis, and eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis
options.B: Giant-cell arteritis, Takayasu arteritis, and polyarteritis nodosa only

mcqs.explanation: The review says AAV is subdivided into granulomatosis with polyangiitis, microscopic polyangiitis, and eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis.

sourceRefs.excerpt: AAV is subdivided into granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA), microscopic polyangiitis (MPA), and eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA) [ ].

mcqs.question: What pathologic and serologic pattern does the review give for these vasculitides?

options.A: Pauci-immune neutrophilic inflammation of small vessels, with antibodies to PR3 or MPO
options.B: Immune-complex deposits in large arteries and anti-GBM antibodies
options.C: Granulomas in every vessel and no ANCA
options.D: Eosinophilic inflammation of the aorta only

mcqs.explanation: The review describes pauci-immune perivascular neutrophilic inflammation with necrosis, associated with antibodies to proteinase 3 or myeloperoxidase, affecting small intraparenchymal arteries, arterioles, capillaries, and venules.

sourceRefs.excerpt: characterized by pauci-immune perivascular neutrophilic inflammation with necrosis and thrombosis. They are associated with autoantibodies that target the neutrophil cytoplasmic proteases: proteinase 3 (PR3) or myeloperoxidase (MPO) [ ].

mcqs.question: Which respiratory pattern does the review call characteristic of granulomatosis with polyangiitis rather than a shared feature?

options.A: Extravascular granulomatous inflammation of the upper and lower respiratory tract
options.B: Adult-onset asthma, which it assigns to granulomatosis with polyangiitis
options.D: Diffuse alveolar haemorrhage as a feature exclusive to granulomatosis with polyangiitis

mcqs.explanation: Extravascular granulomatous inflammation of the upper and lower respiratory tract is a characteristic of granulomatosis with polyangiitis. Kidney disease is frequent in both that disease and microscopic polyangiitis, in 70 to 80 percent.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Extravascular granulomatous inflammation of the upper and lower respiratory tract is a characteristic of GPA. Kidney disease is frequent in both GPA and MPA (70–80%), but less common in EGPA.

mcqs.question: Who does the review say typically has the worst kidney prognosis?

options.A: Patients with MPO-ANCA and microscopic polyangiitis
options.B: Patients with eosinophilic granulomatosis and no kidney disease
options.C: Patients with PR3-ANCA and no renal involvement
options.D: The review says all ANCA subsets have the same kidney outlook

mcqs.explanation: The review says patients with MPO-ANCA and microscopic polyangiitis typically have the worst kidney prognosis because of chronic damage.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Patients with MPO-ANCA and MPA typically have the worst kidney prognosis due to chronic damage [ ].

mcqs.question: How widely does the review say pulmonary capillaritis with diffuse alveolar haemorrhage occurs?

options.A: Across the spectrum of ANCA-associated vasculitis
options.B: Only in eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis
options.C: Only in infection, never in vasculitis
options.D: The review says the lung is never involved

mcqs.explanation: The review says pulmonary capillaritis manifesting as diffuse alveolar haemorrhage can occur across the spectrum of ANCA-associated vasculitis.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Pulmonary capillaritis manifesting as diffuse alveolar haemorrhage can occur across the spectrum of AAV.
